name: Companhia Estadual de Distribuição de Energia Elétrica
summary: Companhia Estadual de Distribuição de Energia Elétrica engages in the distribution of electricity in Brazil. It operates as a concessionaire in the distribution and activities associated with the electric energy services. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Porto Alegre, Brazil. Companhia Estadual de Distribuição de Energia Elétrica operates as a subsidiary of Equatorial Participações e Investimentos S.A.
